cronJob.description:
The {@link CronJob} on the {@link DataTagBase} or {@link DataTag} instances that should have counts persisted.
Usually refers to the {@link CronJob} which called the {@link PopulateDataTagsBatchJob}.

enabledTagsOnly.description:
Whether or not the counts should only be persisted for data tags which have {@link DataTagBase#enabled} set
to true.

isAsync.description:
Whether or not the persisting of the {@link DataTagCountHistory}s based on potentially large scans of tables
should happen in separate {@link AsyncAction}s inside of {@link DataTagCountHistory#persistCounts}.

title:
Specifies the manner and scope with which {@link DataTagCountHistory} instances will be persisted inside
{@link DataTagCountHistory#persistCounts}.
name: PersistDataTagCountsSpec
